notes: Fold clip (Solace / Anchorage 01, ~107 fps): leftover artifact is a horizontal shear of the whole #space canvas during cruise — station, NPC hulls, labels, and starfield offset together — while the HUD stays locked. No white flash. That is a desynchronized/front-buffer present on a 120 Hz Fold panel.

#space stays transparent (2.16.2 white-flash) but is no longer desynchronized. World strokes also keep a 1.4 device-pixel hairline so thin spokes/hulls do not crawl at Fold backing×zoom. Chase camera snaps to backing pixels; distant stars stay unsapped.
Sky bake-before-fill, backing slack, and launch/jump art warmup from 2.16.2 are unchanged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.3. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
